content:
camille: I opened a patch that reorganizes the Private/VPC install guide into a single flow and adds a small offline diagram showing where the kms-proxy and HSM sit. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1301 — please check the HSM section wording, systemd example, and the SDK unix-socket snippets.

sam: skimmed. overall good. Two concerns: 1) HSM PKCS#11 socket path examples should show both default locations and a note for mirrored clusters. 2) We need an explicit cert-bundle step for TLS endpoints when using mtls to the KMS (offline customers trip up here).

lee: I added an SVG under assets/diagrams/offline-kms-topology.svg and updated the relative link in the markdown. Also adjusted alt text for accessibility. I referenced it as: `![offline topology](../assets/diagrams/offline-kms-topology.svg)` — let me know if that path is okay for the docs build.

anton: For systemd, prefer sharing a drop-in snippet for service overrides instead of a full unit. Minimal example to add to the docs:```ini
# /etc/systemd/system/kms-proxy.service.d/10-override.conf
[Service]
Environment=KMS_CONFIG=/etc/redwood/kms-proxy.yaml
Restart=on-failure
LimitNOFILE=65536
User=kms
```
And then `sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo systemctl enable --now kms-proxy`. Add a short troubleshooting note: check `journalctl -u kms-proxy` and `ss -xl` for unix sockets.

camille: Sam can you sketch the cert-bundle step? Maybe a one-liner to concatenate root + intermediate + client cert into a bundle used by the proxy.

sam: Sure — put this under "Offline cert bundling" paragraph:
```bash
# create combined bundle for kms-proxy
cat root.crt intermediate.crt client.crt > /etc/redwood/certs/kms-bundle.pem
chown kms:kms /etc/redwood/certs/kms-bundle.pem
chmod 640 /etc/redwood/certs/kms-bundle.pem
```
Add a note: if using PKCS#11-backed client certs, document how the proxy loads keys versus certs (cert on disk, private key in HSM).

lee: Updated the PKCS#11 examples to include `/var/run/hsm/pkcs11.sock` and a fallback `/var/lib/hsm/pkcs11.sock` with a brief sentence about permissions. Also added a quick `setfacl -m u:kms:rw /var/run/hsm/pkcs11.sock` example.

docs-bot: lint report: link-check: 0 broken links, spelling: 2 warnings ("certsbundle" -> "certs bundle", "unixsocket" -> "unix socket"), accessibility: svg alt missing in one case (fixed by lee). CI preview: https://deploy-preview-1301--docs.redwood.ai/private-vpc-install

anton: One more SDK nit: the Python example currently constructs a url with `unix://` + path string. Suggest using pathlib to avoid accidental double slashes and to call the client with `endpoint=path.as_posix()` when needed. Small snippet to include:```py
from pathlib import Path
path = Path('/var/run/hsm/pkcs11.sock')
client = KMSClient(endpoint=f'unix://{path.as_posix()}')
```
Also show both `unix://` and `tls://` examples.

camille: Good catch. I'll merge once anton and sam approve the final patches. @lee can you squash the diagram commit into the docs patch and update the PR description to note the assets path?

sam: lgtm for cert step and HSM notes.

anton: lgtm for systemd and SDK snippets.

camille: merging in 10m unless anyone objects. Thanks all :shipit:
